title: Rabbi Hafni bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 56:5. Hyman reports that the Radal reads R’ Chanina bar Yitzchak. In Yalkut Shimoni on Nachum, remez 561, the reading is Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa.

notes.text: The locator פנ״דה and the abbreviated patronymic ב״י remain unresolved. Hyman reports distinct Chanina readings.

The saved whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah56:5 scalar explicitly has Rabbi Chafni bar Yitzchak; the saved whole Yalkut Shimoni on Nach561 scalar has Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa for the corresponding saying. These support the two named occurrences and56:5 comparison alongside פנ״דה, not a proved glyph history. Hyman attributes the different Chanina ב״י reading to Radal; that uninspected commentator occurrence retains R' and literal ב״י.

Hyman’s print (vol. II, p. 520) has פנ״ו־ה, where the supplied Hebrew has פנ״דה. The consulted Bereshit Rabbah 56:5 names Rabbi Hafni bar Yitzchak. In note 12 on that passage, the consulted digital edition of the Radal’s commentary proposes “R’ Chanina bar Yitzchak,” spelling out the patronymic abbreviated in Hyman as ב״י. It also reports the distinct Yalkut reading, Chanina bar Pappa, which appears in the consulted text of remez 561.
